purpose: Bounded historical-date checks of MLB Stats API active-roster snapshots: Boston transactions and Juan Soto’s Yankees-to-Mets move.

assertions.independent_evidence: Boston placed Story on the 10-day injured list and recalled David Hamilton on Apr. 7, 2024.
Same Apr. 7 official club announcement confirms his recall to fill Story’s active-roster spot.
Boston selected Mayer to the active Major League roster on May 24, 2025.

assertions.expected: present with NYY teamId 147; absent from NYM teamId 121

independent_evidence.description: MLB’s Apr. 9 Yankees video records Soto’s RBI single in the Marlins-Yankees game, confirming he appeared for NYY on the snapshot date.

assertions.expected: present with NYM teamId 121; absent from NYY teamId 147

independent_evidence.description: Official MLB starting lineups list Soto batting third as the Mets’ RF on May 31; the official scoreboard links the Mets-Rockies game box score.
Official MLB scoreboard for May 31, including the Mets-Rockies final and box-score link.

transition_evidence.description: The Mets announced signing four-time All-Star Juan Soto on Dec. 11, 2024, corroborating the change of club between the two snapshot dates.

assessment: Selected Boston roster moves and Soto’s club assignment agree with official records on both dates. These checks support historical date behavior but do not verify every roster member.
limitations: This is a bounded spot-check of selected players at three clubs on two dates, not a comprehensive validation of all 30 clubs.

The MLB Stats API responses were retrieved in 2026 with date parameters; the API does not provide an archived retrieval receipt from the original date. Official transactions independently support the checked inclusion/exclusion states but do not prove every roster entry or exact intraday cutoff.
Anthony’s ID 701350 was confirmed by MLB’s player page; it is correct.

The non-Boston check confirms Soto’s dated club assignment and uses official MLB game evidence for both dates; the Apr. 9 evidence is an official in-game highlight rather than a linked box-score page. This remains a bounded two-date, two-club spot-check, not full 30-club verification.
